notes: All 18 source and 30 target IDs partition exactly once.

*to this end* is not a `noncompositional` unit: rule 45's closing clause covers exactly this shape, the ASV spreading the phrase over words answering to each token, so *to … end* is the preposition's headed on *to* and *this* is the demonstrative's — the same division rule 78 records for `διὰ τοῦτο` → *For this cause*.

`ἠλπίκαμεν` → *we have our hope set* heads on *hope* under rules 17 and 91, that being the word the corpus spends on the lexeme; the supplied *our* has no other source word to belong to and rides inside the unit.
`θεῷ ζῶντι` is anarthrous, so rule 58 gives the supplied *the* to the noun, discontinuously around *living*.
`πιστῶν` is a substantival adjective with no article, so rule 58's substantival clause gives it the whole supplied *of them that believe*, headed on the word glossing the lexeme.
s006 carries the selected reading r01 under rule 12; no new textual decision was made here.
